headline: Foreign Portfolio Investors Pour ₹45,960 Crore into Indian Equities in a Single Week
summary: Foreign portfolio investors bought ₹45,960 crore of Indian equities in a week, surpassing October's total outflows, supported by easing crude prices and strong corporate earnings.
why: Foreign institutional flows are a major driver of liquidity and valuation trends in Indian financial markets.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Heavy foreign portfolio inflows provide strong buying support for Indian equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A massive influx of ₹45,960 crore in foreign portfolio investments, spurred by easing crude prices and solid corporate earnings, drove strong market sentiment.
